title: Resolve canonical source for 3 legacy references
description:
As discovered in kanbus-88ab2a, there are exactly 3 accepted references in production that lack both a source attachment and a resolvable canonical URI, causing them to be blocked at the find stage gate.

These references need their canonical sources resolved so they can be processed for URL text extraction.

Blocked Reference IDs:
- reference-knowledge-corpus-ai-ml-journalism-web-businessinsider-openclaw-token-bill-2026-5-v1
- reference-knowledge-corpus-ai-ml-research-context-rot-4-v1
- reference-knowledge-corpus-ai-ml-research-yann-lecun-path-towards-autonomous-machine-intelligence-openreview-v1
